render_evidence.grammar_note: «запланированное на» governs both shapes: a bare clock («на 10:30») and a date+clock («на 14 окт. 21:30»). The round-2 wording «которое сработает 10:30» was ungrammatical for the common same-day shape because it omitted the preposition; adding «в» would have fixed only that shape and broken the dated one. Neuter agreement with «пробуждение» is correct in both.
